leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom useDebounce hook that delays execution of a function
Configure the debounce delay parameter to control timing behavior
Apply the useDebounce hook to handle user input in a search component
Initialize state variables to manage debounced values within React components
Integrate the debounced function with event handlers for real-time input
Render UI elements that respond to debounced state updates
Manipulate the debounce behavior by adjusting delay values dynamically
